name: Motion-Compensated Algebraic Reconstruction Technique
aliases: Functional extended from ART for motion compensation
definition: An extension of ART for deforming volumes that warps the volume with a displacement field u(x,t) before projection, and unwarp the correction term before updating the static reference volume.
summary: Motion-Compensated Algebraic Reconstruction Technique reconstructs deforming volumes from moving scans by warping the volume according to a motion field, unlike standard ART which assumes static objects.
